formula: recency=2^(-age/45); evidence score is difficulty*recency weighted correctness with repeated-misconception penalty; confidence uses all effective evidence and stability; positive_exposure=1-exp(-correct_effective_evidence/12), capped at 0.99; visible mastery=0+positive_exposure*(evidence_score-0). This keeps confidence separate and guarantees that an added wrong answer cannot raise visible mastery.
scope: SUBTOPIC direct; LESSON equal active subtopic aggregation; CATEGORY Stage3-weighted lesson aggregation; TAG deferred
reference_tests: zero-origin v1 monotonic regression suite included and locally validated
